WorkspaceSnapshot.title: WorkspaceSnapshot
WorkspaceSnapshot.description: Persisted Google Co-Scientist UM-1 workspace state for an authenticated researcher.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

ownerEmail.description: Verified email address of the researcher.

researchGoal.description: Active Google Co-Scientist overarching research objective.

payloadJson.description: Serialized JSON payload containing claims, withdrawals, preflightLogs, and externalLogs.

claimCount.description: Number of registered claims and frozen EXP records.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last workspace update.

CoScientistChatLog.title: CoScientistChatLog
CoScientistChatLog.description: Persisted multi-turn Co-Scientist agent conversation history for an authenticated researcher.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the conversation owner.

messagesJson.description: Serialized JSON array of chat messages and grounding metadata.

messageCount.description: Count of messages in the thread.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last message update.

/workspaces/{workspaceId}.description: Stores each researcher's complete UM-1 claims, dependency ledgers, preflight logs, and external verification logs keyed by UID.

/chatThreads/{threadId}.description: Stores each researcher's Google Co-Scientist multi-turn conversation thread keyed by UID.
